label: sparse: early original steps of f-initial sequences / late copy-phase x inputs
explanation: Very sparse (0.02% of steps), weak magnitudes (max 0.22). Two loose concentrations: (1) original-phase steps t=2-3 in sequences starting with f, especially right after a c or o (e.g. f u c [r]); (2) copy-phase steps late in long sequences (recall_idx>=4) where the input is x (49% of mass) or m. Neither context is selective: x inputs late in the copy phase fire under 2% of the time, and f-initial early steps about 10%. The best disjunction gets dev precision 0.05 and recall 0.40 (F1 0.09). Never fires at t=0-1 or after a copy error. Magnitude is roughly flat across these contexts; no modulator was identified.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: x, m, b, 0; input phase: x, r, n, f; delimiter step: ) and the next token to output (most: f, z, b, x, h, e; least: y, a, k, t); timing cues that raise it most: t=3, L=3 & t=5, t=2.
